literature.abstract: Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) is a rare disease in children and the treatment option before the allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) is rarely reported. clinical_trials.title: A Phase I Multicenter Study of Arsenic Trioxide and Azacitidine in Patients With Myelodysplastic Syndromes
clinical_trials.brief_summary:
RATIONALE: Drugs used in chemotherapy, such as azacitidine and arsenic trioxide, work in different ways to stop the growth of cancer cells, either by killing the cells or by stopping them from dividing. Giving more than one drug (combination chemotherapy) may kill more cancer cells.

PURPOSE: This phase I/II trial is studying the side effects and best dose of azacitidine when given together with arsenic trioxide and to see how well they work in treating patients with myelodysplastic syndromes.

literature.title: Myelodysplastic syndromes: 2015 Update on diagnosis, risk-stratification and management.
literature.abstract: The myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) are a very heterogeneous group of myeloid disorders characterized by peripheral blood cytopenias and increased risk of transformation to acute myelogenous leukemia (AML). MDS occurs more frequently in older males and in individuals with prior exposure to cytotoxic therapy.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 再生不良性貧血（aregenerative anemia）在 MDS 背景下最常見，反映造血幹細胞功能衰竭。Azacitidine 透過去甲基化機轉可重啟造血相關基因表達，改善骨髓造血功能；此外，pmid:34781359 直接展示 azacitidine 對 X 染色體連鎖含鐵血球性貧血的療效，提供非 MDS 相關貧血的獨立藥理支撐。

predicted_indications.disease_name: severe congenital hypochromic anemia with ringed sideroblasts

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 先天性含鐵血球性貧血（XLSA/congenital sideroblastic anemia）涉及血紅素合成基因（如 ALAS2）異常或粒線體功能缺陷。雖此資料集無直接證據，但 pmid:34781359（同樣在 aregenerative anemia 分析中列出）顯示 azacitidine 可能透過上調 ALAS2 基因表達或改變骨髓環境而發揮作用，構成間接生物學假說。屬罕見遺傳性疾病，基因療法/吡哆醇為首選。
5q35 微複製症候群（NSD1 基因區域重複）為先天性染色體微重複，導致 Sotos 症候群表現型（過度生長、智力障礙）。與 del(5q) MDS 的染色體異常性質截然不同。目前無任何臨床或基礎研究顯示 azacitidine 與此症的相關性；TxGNN 高分可能源自染色體 5 相關基因節點的圖譜近鄰效應。
神經性肌萎縮（Parsonage-Turner syndrome）為免疫媒介的臂神經叢神經病變，與 SEPT9 基因突變相關（遺傳性）。雖然 SEPT9 基因的甲基化在某些腫瘤中具有生物標誌意義，但目前無證據顯示 azacitidine 的去甲基化作用能改善神經叢損傷的發炎或修復機轉。
肌萎縮性神經痛（amyotrophic neuralgia）與神經性肌萎縮（neuralgic amyotrophy）高度重疊，為同一臨床實體的不同命名。評估結論與 neuralgic amyotrophy 相同：無臨床或機轉依據支持 azacitidine 使用。TxGNN 評分可能因圖譜中神經系統疾病節點的高度連結性而產生過度預測。
家族性血小板增多症（MPL 或 THPO 基因突變）為良性遺傳性骨髓增生異常，血栓風險高。雖 Azacitidine 被用於骨髓纖維化（MF）的後線治療，但家族性血小板增多症病理機轉（JAK/STAT 持續激活）與 MDS 的甲基化沉默機轉不同，HMA 的療效理由薄弱。此資料集完全無支持證據。
